edbDesc: A number of phenomena in which an electromagnetic wave propagates through a medium that has been altered by the presence of a quasistatic magnetic field. Includes the Faraday Effect and the Magneto-Optic Kerr Effect.
title: Magneto-Optic Effects
pickWhy: An umbrella for several effects (Faraday, magneto-optic Kerr, Voigt) that have their own entries.
